title: Excalibur Air Apparent Special Edition Marvel 1991 Squarebound Simonson Cover
conditionDescription: Reading copy: cover surface peeling/chipping along the top and outer edges of front and back covers, small hole on the back cover. Spine intact. See photos.
descriptionText:
Excalibur: Air Apparent Special Edition (December 1991), Marvel Comics - 48-page squarebound giant, no ads. Excalibur vs. a re-created Air-Walker sent by Galactus. Written by Scott Lobdell, art by Ron Lim, Dwayne Turner, Jackson Guice, Rick Leonardi, Erik Larsen, James Fry and more; cover by Walt Simonson. $4.95 cover price.

Back cover: Excalibur team pin-up (Captain Britain, Meggan, Shadowcat, Nightcrawler, Phoenix).

Condition: reading copy. The cover coating is peeling and chipped along the top and outer edges of both the front and back covers, and there is a small hole on the back cover (see close-up photos). Spine and binding intact.

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
